structured_output.what_is_happening: A token copying the ticker and name of PAID (UsePaid) was created about 13 minutes before detection. It trades in a pool set up directly on PumpSwap: the mint has no "pump" suffix and migrated_unix is 0. The real UsePaid token is 98kfF7rmsg1QDUEoCqNE7g7M1FdrTt92TEp2CLzypump (about $47M market cap, with KuCoin and Bitrue coverage). The copy borrowed the @UsePaid X handle for its GeckoTerminal metadata. Buying has been one-sided, with 1,198 unique buyers against 51 sellers, most likely confused or bot buyers chasing the PAID name. The creator still holds 19% and 100% of the LP is unlocked.

narrative.description: UsePaid is a real, growing product that routes pump.fun creator fees to X accounts via X Money. Its token 98kf...pump ran to a $30-50M market cap in September 2026.
narrative.why_spreading: The real PAID token has momentum and media coverage (KuCoin flash news). Copycat launches try to catch spillover buyers who search for the ticker.

authenticity.evidence: 1,198 unique buyers vs 51 unique sellers in 13 minutes is unnaturally lopsided. The creator holds 19% and the LP is unlocked. The mint is not a pump.fun mint and the pool was set up directly on PumpSwap, so the dev controls the liquidity. Searching the contract address turned up no organic posts.

The creator holds 19% of supply and can dump it into about $49k of liquidity

structured_output.counterargument: Spillover demand from the real PAID token is strong: over 1,100 buyers in 13 minutes and $340k of volume on a $55k market cap. The creator's previous token reached a $330k ATH.

structured_output.thesis: This is a ticker-hijack copy of the hot UsePaid PAID token. The pool is dev-controlled with unlocked LP, and the creator holds 19%. Confusion buying can bring brief pumps, but a rug or dump is more likely than a clean 2x from the entry after the move has already gone up 300%.
